item.title: Subarashiki Hibi ~Furenzoku Sonzai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KeroQ
  • 発売日: 2010-03-26
  • スコア: 8.68/10 (11831 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 素晴らしき日々～不連続存在～
  • 英語名: Subarashiki Hibi Furenzoku Sonzai

别名

  • Subarashiki Hibi Furenzoku Sonzai

あらすじ

One day, Minakami Yuki witnesses a stuffed toy falling through the air. Battered and worn, how many times has this doll fluttered downwards, released as an attempted offering to the sky? An offering made to find the “day we return to the sky”—a ritual passed down in this town since times gone by. Those efforts shall come to fruition in the place where the girls of earth and sky meet.

item.title: Moekan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KeroQ
  • 発売日: 2003-01-31
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (77 人評価)
  • 日本語名: モエかん
  • 英語名: Moekan

别名

  • Moekko Company

あらすじ

The title follows Takahiro, an enigmatic man served unquestioningly by five beautiful maids with equally mysterious pasts tied to his. Primarily set within a secluded mansion estate, the story is a combination of humor, romance, and surprisingly dark violence; all revealing the exact nature of their association and shared questionable future. The game features three distinct styles of high quality artwork: a tradition style for storytelling, a super-deformed style for comedic events, and a blood red gothic style for the darker moments.

item.title: Nijuuei
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KeroQ
  • 発売日: 2000-11-30
  • スコア: 7.58/10 (96 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 二重影
  • 英語名: Nijuuei

别名

  • Double Shadow

あらすじ

17th year of the Kan’ei era (1640). The echoes of the Warring States period had yet to die out; rounin still roamed the land in search of employment and food, while even among the shogun’s own retainers swordsmen prowled the streets cutting down passersby without cause.

In that forsaken world reeking of death, a mysterious swordsman wanders. His name — Futatsukage Sougen.

item.title: Tsui no Sora
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KeroQ
  • 発売日: 1999-08-27
  • スコア: 6.8/10 (853 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 終ノ空
  • 英語名: Tsui no Sora

别名

  • ツイノソラ

あらすじ

Yukito Minakami is awakened by his childhood friend Kotomi for school, but when they arrive there, they find that a female classmate jumped off the roof of the school the day before. Before long, all their classmates are talking about the approaching end of the world on the 20th day of the month. Some even begin to lose their minds, with another student as their leader…
